name: The Signal

artwork.title: Bohemia.
artwork.description: 四道明暗人像组成菱形，歌剧拱门与酒红帷幕围绕金色灯光，呼应 Queen《波西米亚狂想曲》的戏剧性。

heading: 理性的噪声
intro: 机器学习、基础模型、机器人与闭环系统。把模型如何工作、为何失效、如何走进现实写下来。

tracks.title: Comfortably Uncertain
tracks.note: 机器学习基础、概率、不确定性、泛化与校准。

tracks.title: Wish You Were Real
tracks.note: VLA、具身智能、机器人操作与 Sim-to-Real。
tracks.inspiration: Pink Floyd · Wish You Were Here

tracks.title: The Dark Side of the Model
tracks.note: AI 模型局限、失败案例、Benchmark 与研究反思。
tracks.inspiration: Pink Floyd · The Dark Side of the Moon

tracks.title: While My Model Gently Dreams
tracks.note: 世界模型、生成模型与未来状态预测。
tracks.inspiration: The Beatles · While My Guitar Gently Weeps

tracks.title: Stairway to Latent Space
tracks.note: 表示学习、Embedding 与多模态潜在空间。

tracks.title: A Kind of Emergence

tracks.title: Highway to Inference
tracks.note: 模型推理、工程部署、推理速度、延迟与性能优化。

tracks.title: The Loop Must Go On
tracks.note: 强化学习、Agent Loop、Harness 与反馈驱动的迭代。
tracks.inspiration: Queen · The Show Must Go On

name: The Afterglow

artwork.title: endless refrain.
artwork.description: 冷紫雨夜、窗上雨线与水面回响构成的原创封套，灵感来自 X JAPAN 的《ENDLESS RAIN》。

heading: 感性的回响
intro: 摇滚、吉他、摄影、日常与旅途。重要的不是写得多完整，而是把值得记住的片刻留下。

tracks.title: 39 Frames Later
tracks.note: 摄影、镜头、光线与被快门留住的瞬间。

tracks.title: Art of Becoming
tracks.note: 成长、选择、阅读与关于自己的思考。

tracks.title: After the Encore
tracks.note: X JAPAN、Queen、日本摇滚、专辑与音乐随笔。

tracks.title: Forever in Distortion
tracks.note: 电吉他、练习、音色、设备与音乐创作。

tracks.title: These Are the Days
tracks.note: 日常记录、生活碎片与值得保存的小事。
tracks.inspiration: Queen · These Are the Days of Our Lives

tracks.title: Across Two Worlds
tracks.note: 旅行、城市、异乡与不同文化之间的观察。
